# ankra_organisation (Resource)

An Ankra organisation, created with the token's user as its admin. The counterpart of `ankra org create`.

~> **Destroy does not delete the organisation.** The API offers no organisation delete or rename to API tokens, so `terraform destroy` only removes the organisation from state and warns; delete it in the portal. For the same reason changing `name` or `country` is refused at plan time rather than planned as a replacement, which would create a second organisation and leave the first in place.

The platform also makes a newly created organisation its creator's current organisation in the portal.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Destroy only forgets the organisation: delete it in the portal.
resource "ankra_organisation" "staging" {
  name    = "Acme Staging"
  country = "SE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Organisation name. It cannot be changed through the API.

### Optional

- `country` (String) Country code recorded at creation. The platform never returns it, so it is not read back, and it cannot be changed through the API.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organisation id.
- `slug` (String) URL slug the platform derived from the name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Organisations are imported by id.
terraform import ankra_organisation.staging 6f1c2b8e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
